# LicensingMadeSimple

> Who needs which U.S. business license, and where to file it.

LicensingMadeSimple is a 50-state directory for collection and accounts receivable management, consumer and commercial lending, money transmitters, and mortgage. Each state license page names the license, the agency, and the filing path.

Fee, bond, and timeline cells are filled only when a state regulator or NMLS page was checked on the date shown. A blank cell is not an estimate. Montana, Washington, and Maryland money transmitter pages carry the most detail.

## Priority pages

- [Montana money transmitters](https://licensingmadesimple.com/states/montana/money-transmitters): The Division of Banking and Financial Institutions states that it does not regulate money transmitters. No state fee, bond, or application timeline.
- [Washington money transmitters](https://licensingmadesimple.com/states/washington/money-transmitters): Department of Financial Institutions fee page and RCW 19.230.050 bond. The timeline cell is blank.
- [Maryland money transmitters](https://licensingmadesimple.com/states/maryland/money-transmitters): Financial Institutions Article sections 12-407 and 12-412, and COMAR 09.03.14.05.

## Directory

- [License types](https://licensingmadesimple.com/directory): Collection, lending, money transmitters, and mortgage.
- [States](https://licensingmadesimple.com/states): All 50 states.
- [NMLS guide](https://licensingmadesimple.com/guides/nmls): What the filing system is.

## Related tools

- [LicenseStore costs](https://licensestore.com/costs/): Cited government and NMLS fee lines.
- [LicenseStore money transmitter costs](https://licensestore.com/costs/money-transmitters/): Money transmitter fee lines.
- [LicenseStore compare](https://licensestore.com/compare/): DIY and provider filing paths. Service charges are quotes.
- [LicenseStore sources](https://licensestore.com/sources/): Source list for the cost desk.
- [Cornerstone Licensing](https://cornerstonelicensing.com): Prepares and files the application.
